Solara Medical Supplies
distributes
major diabetes management brands and equipment manufacturers
, specializing in continuous glucose monitors (CGMs), insulin pumps, and testing consumables.
Key Manufacturers and Brands Distributed
Dexcom:
Supplier of major CGM systems including the Dexcom G6 and G7 series.
Abbott Diabetes Care:
Distributor of the FreeStyle Libre continuous glucose monitoring systems.
Tandem Diabetes Care:
Provider of durable automated insulin delivery systems like the t:slim X2.
Medtronic:
Distributor of MiniMed insulin pumps and related diabetes management devices.
Insulet Corporation:
Provider of the Omnipod tubeless disposable insulin management systems.

Solara Medical Supplies
is
a large American direct-to-patient distributor of advanced diabetes management products
. Founded in 2002 and headquartered in Chula Vista, California, the company specializes in home delivery of continuous glucose monitors (CGMs), insulin pumps, patch pumps, and related testing accessories.
Solara Medical Supplies
Company Details & History
Services
: Direct shipping of diabetes medical devices, working alongside Medicare and hundreds of private insurance networks.
